title: UT Pre-Advanced Argentine Tango – Learn Back Sacadas
standardsTitle: UT Pre-Advanced Argentine Tango – Learn Back Sacadas
description:
Sacada means displacement

Back sacadas require all the tango technique normally necessary to perform regular displacement plus a good understanding of torsions, pivots, timing, and movement delay.

Torsions, pivots, over-pivoting
We will work on torsions, pivots, over pivoting (without disturbing your partner axis and losing connection and balance), ability to walk while in overturned position, plus other necessary elements so the back sacada can be freely introduced during the improvised dance.

READ MORE: https://www.ultimatetango.com/preadvanced
REGISTER: https://UltimateTango.as.me/Pre-Advanced-Course-May2023

title: UT Advanced Argentine Tango – Elaborate exploration
standardsTitle: UT Advanced Argentine Tango – Elaborate exploration
description:
A challenge

We can be happy once we speak conversational Tango, or we can yearn for more. If Tango is like language – there surely there must be more! And it is!

Tango never stops. And that’s the beauty of it. There is always more. And as we become more and more comfortable with the fundamentals, navigation, musicality, new element, and different styles, we look for more.

The advanced course challenges you to a more elaborate exploration of more advanced tango elements. Each 4 weeks cycle is focused on introducing new intricate variations, investigating new possibilities, and mastering combinations involving elements originally introduced to you during the pre-Advanced courses.

PLEASE NOTE: The Advanced level freely mixes all elements taught in the Pre-Advanced level and adds more variations. Please be considerate – if you have difficulties with basic to the cross or molinete, call boleo a bolero, and gancho a gaucho – PLEASE do not register for this class. Once you are at this level, you won’t appreciate people randomly showing up and defying the whole purpose of this class. THANK YOU!

REGISTER HERE: https://UltimateTango.as.me/Advanced-Course-May2023

description:
Queer Milonga!
Sunday, July 20, 2025
6 PM: Pre-milonga class on milonga
7 pm to 10 pm: Milonga
Location: The Allston Abbey, 5 St Lukes Rd, Allston, MA 02134
DJ: Karen Johnson

Pre-Milonga Class + Milonga: $22-$40/ $30 suggested
Milonga: $12-$30/ $20 suggested
We operate using a sliding scale.

How it works: The suggested amount allows us to break even on operational costs. Donating a little bit extra helps folks who have access to less and pays it forward to our future events.

No one will be turned away due to lack of funds.

Things to know about our Milonga:

We’re queer! Be prepared for cabaceos from anyone, and don’t assume role preference based on presentation. All are welcome, as long as you are prepared to be part of a queer-centered event.

QTB endeavors to create a warm and joyful space that is inclusive of dancers of all experience levels and backgrounds. Introduce yourself to new faces!

Accessibility

Masking is optional but encouraged, with masks free at the door. That being said… if you see a mask, wear a mask. We ask that you wear a mask if your partner is wearing one. We hope to have air filters on in the space. If you are sick, please stay home!

title: Wednesday Tango Break– 8pm Intermediate Tango Classes
standardsTitle: Wednesday Tango Break– 8pm Intermediate Tango Classes
description:
WELCOME FEBRUARY–THE MONTH OF LOVE AND FRIENDSHIP!!

The Tango Society of Boston sponsors Mid-week Tango Dance breaks every Wednesday — Boston’s largest informal Milonga (Tango social dance) and Tango lessons.

Features a lesson in Argentine Tango for Beginning to intermediate dancers (and open to newcomers). No prior experience or partner required.

Schedule
7:00-8:00: Beginners Tango with Guillermo Merlo. This class is for beginners and those wishing to brush up some new techniques.
8:00-9:00: Adv-Intermediate Tango Class with Guillermo Merlo –Theme changes every month

This month, the Intermediate+ class wilL work on:
“GANCHOS INTERNOS”. (Inside Ganchos)
“Ganchos Internos” “inside hooks” are movements where one of the partner’s legs hooks around or behind the partner’s leg in a fluid and coordinated manner.
These Ganchos can be done by both the leader and the follower, to create a dynamic and expressive connection during the dance. They are also used to add variety and embellishments to the dance as well as to communicate emotions and sensations during the dance
Because Ganchos Internos require good control of balance, posture and embrace technique to ensure they are performed safely and harmoniously, Maestro Guillermo will review and emphasize the correct techniques to practice to achieve this.

description:

description:

title: Milonga Sal Azul
description:
Dear Tango Friends,

We are thrilled to invite you to Milonga Sal Azul, a warm and vibrant Argentine tango gathering every Thursday night at Blue Salt Restaurant! 💃🕺

What makes it special?
Milonga Sal Azul is a community-driven space where dancers come together to enjoy beautiful tandas, great company, and the magic of tango. Each night offers a unique experience with rotating hosts and talented DJs setting the mood.

📅 Schedule:

  • 7:00 PM – 8:00 PM | Tango Lesson for Beginners ($10)
  • 8:00 PM – 12:00 AM | Milonga ($20, includes a glass of wine 🍷)
  • Enjoy a delicious European fusion dinner in a cozy and inviting setting. Friends and family are welcome to join for dinner or drinks and watch you dance!
  • Plenty of free street parking
  • 5-minute walk from the nearest bus stop

Our goal is to create a BA-style milonga where everyone feels at home—whether you’re a seasoned dancer or just beginning your tango journey.

Come dance with us every Thursday at Blue Salt Restaurant—we can’t wait to share this beautiful experience with you!

Join our community and stay updated by visiting our Facebook group. 💙

With abrazos,
The Milonga Sal Azul Team

title: Argentine Tango in West Hartford, CT
standardsTitle: Argentine Tango in West Hartford, CT
description:
Do you tango? Tango Sueño Academy returns to Hartford area, at the Fred Astaire West Hartford starting April. Join us for weekly Saturday tango!

– 11:30 – 12:30 am: Essentials for all
– 12:30 – 1:30 pm: Intermediate tango
privates by appointment
$25 one hour, $40 both (with monthly registration),
IN APRIL ONLY: first hour $15 (save 40%) second hour $15 ($30 both)
Registration and further details: www.tangosueno.com

__________

Tango Sueño Academy is the premier Argentine Tango school in Connecticut, serving elite dancers for more than 18 years under the direction of Jorge “Gem” Duras. The group and private lessons focus on authentic Argentine Tango as danced and performed in the halls of Buenos Aires. The classes take place in Stamford, New Haven, Hartford and Danbury metropolitan areas as well as Westchester NY.

Gem has been dancing Argentine Tango for more than 26 years and teaching professionally since 2003. He trains and encourages his students to acquire the proper tango technique, so that they can create the sensuality, musicality and partner connection that the Argentine Tango is famous for.

Although Tango Sueño Academy offers choreography and performance classes for more advanced students, the essence of tango “where the two partners become one” is never forgotten, with the goal of enabling the students to dance with others at local tango events and throughout the world including Buenos Aires.

title: TANGO 2 + 3: INTERMEDIATE
description:
TANGO 2+3: INTERMEDIATE
At the beginning of each month a new series on a new topic begins.

MAR 8, 15, 22, 29 // $100

– Pre-Registration for is required

Instructor: Mia Dalglish
1:15- 2:30pm

Course Description: This class is for people with a little prior experience in tango. We will be working on building a strong foundation of leading + following techniques so there is clear communication when moving as a couple. This class works on basic vocabulary of tango, and putting it in the line of dance.

Registration:
PAYMENT // Cancellation + Purchasing Policy for Group Lessons:

– Registration for Tango 2 + 3 is done by the series (no drop-ins). Registration is still permitted with up to one class absence per series, however, we must be informed at the time of registration. In this case, the Single Class Pass rate ($30 per session) will be charged for the number of sessions you are attending.

– Full payment is due on the first day of each series. All payments are non-refundable and non-transferrable to future sessions. Refunds and / or class credit will not be issued for absences that are not planned by the first day of the series. ​

– Your spot is reserved especially for you, so these classes are not transferable to another person (unless prior consent is given from Instructor).

– To get the discounted series price, you must register for the full series.

– If you are unable to complete the class due to an illness, injury or any other circumstance you must notify your instructor to let them know you will be absent. Your instructor will let you know if there is a makeup class that you can attend at another time during the week.
